person.name: Muhammad Uzair
person.line: I build AI that people talk to.
person.summary: Five years in data science and machine learning, the last three putting language models into products. Most recently Aida, an AI financial adviser, where the answers had to be right as well as fast. I like problems where the model is only half the job; the rest is making it quick, keeping the data honest, and getting it into people’s hands.

facts: Based in the UK and open to relocation.
Speaks English fluently; Urdu and Pashto are native languages.
Five years in data science and machine learning, the last three putting language models into products.

roles.title: AI Engineer
roles.context: Aida was an AI financial adviser. I was responsible for the parts of it that understood what a user said, remembered it, and used it in later conversations. Money Means closed in October 2026.

points.title: Aida’s chat agent
points.text: Owned the language-model agent behind Aida’s chat: tool selection, conversation flow, and how facts a user shared were captured and reused.

points.title: Tool selection step
points.text: Designed the step that decides which tools the model sees for each message, so it picked the right one far more often.

points.title: Agent tool contracts
points.text: Set the patterns the team built agent tools against: a typed contract per tool, structured JSON output per model call, and one place that defines what each tool needs before it can run.

points.title: Model routing and failover
points.text: Routed models per task, a small model for classification and tool selection and a larger one for the reply, with automatic failover; migrated services between model generations without regressions.

points.title: Single-call extraction
points.text: Replaced a multi-call extraction loop with a single-call design that was markedly faster, with no loss in accuracy.

points.title: Prompt caching
points.text: Introduced prompt caching across all model calls by separating the fixed and per-turn parts of each prompt.

points.title: Per-turn context
points.text: Owned what the model saw each turn (history, rolling summary, user profile) so accuracy held as conversations grew.

points.title: Guarded financial data writes
points.text: Designed how the agent read and wrote financial data: typed profile writes behind a confidence threshold, tools gated on what the user’s accounts contained, and no unvalidated writes from the model.

points.title: Agent regression tests
points.text: Built automated regression testing for the agent: fixed conversation datasets with expected tool calls and outputs, run on every prompt, tool and model change.

points.title: Prompt-assembly visualiser
points.text: Built a prompt-assembly visualiser that showed exactly what the model saw on any turn.

roles.title: Full Stack Data Scientist
roles.context: Data science and backend work for a vehicle fleet business: research, proof-of-concept builds, statistical analysis and deployment pipelines for internal teams.

points.title: Conversational analytics
points.text: Developed and deployed conversational data-visualisation services using LLMs and Dash, so non-technical users could query real-time analytics in plain language.

points.title: AI research briefs
points.text: Evaluated new AI tools and wrote research briefs that senior leadership used to decide what to invest in.

points.title: Fleet utilisation system
points.text: Built a vehicle utilisation and monitoring system that cut manual reporting by 70%.

points.title: MSSQL to PostgreSQL migration
points.text: Migrated databases from MSSQL to PostgreSQL with no data loss, improving query performance.

roles.title: Co-founder
roles.context: A start-up building a web product that helped people talk through personal issues from both an emotional and a rational perspective. I owned the backend and deployment in a small team; we paused in late 2023 when funding ran out.

points.title: Open-source LLM features
points.text: Used open-source language models for the product’s AI features, and curated the datasets behind them.

points.title: RAG with Qdrant and Pinecone
points.text: Built retrieval-augmented generation with Qdrant and Pinecone, so the product’s answers were grounded in retrieved sources.

points.title: APIs and deployment
points.text: Built Flask REST APIs backed by MongoDB, containerised them with Docker and deployed them on AWS Fargate with AWS CDK, with SSL for HTTPS.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.context: Python, machine learning and deep learning to speed up data collection and research at an early-stage start-up.

points.title: Web scraper, 500k records
points.text: Developed a Python web scraper that collected over half a million descriptions and stock quotes.

points.title: ML and image models
points.text: Designed and built the start-up’s machine-learning models on my own, and tested CNN image models (VGG-16, Inception).

roles.title: System Support Engineer
roles.context: Technical support and IT services for clients: set up, administered and tuned Oracle databases and Red Hat Linux systems, including backup and recovery with RMAN and Data Pump.

education.note: Thesis: NLP sentiment analysis using deep learning and transfer learning to work around limited training data.
